capabilityLog.detail: C-05 `app.setOutput` selects the operator under A3D_QR_CORE_OUTPUT (aces is the frozen default); flag-off keeps the single "aces" present path.
A3D_QR_CORE_OUTPUT adds the r185 AgX operator via `app.setOutput`/?aura3d-tonemap; flag-off has no public selector.
A3D_QR_CORE_OUTPUT adds the Khronos PBR Neutral operator via `app.setOutput`; flag-off has no public selector.
`app.setOutput({ exposure })` multiplies into u_exposure under A3D_QR_CORE_OUTPUT (spec.exposure stays un-wired: createAuraApp takes no exposure option).
No public mapSize/bias/normalBias/frustum options; spec asks mapSize 2048, bias -0.0005, normalBias 0.02, extent 6. Observed values are in extra.shadows.

primitives.sphere/cylinder expose no segment options; production meshes are fixed (sphere 16x12, cylinder 24 segments, no cylinder UVs/tangents). three.js side uses SphereGeometry(64x32), CylinderGeometry(48).
